segments.text: That faith is ordinarily begot by the preaching of the Goſpel, or word of Chriſt, without reſpect to any power or capacitie in the creature, but it is wholly paſſive, being dead in ſinnes and treſpaſſes, doth beleeve, and is converted by no leſſe power, then that which raiſed Chriſt from the dead.
